Success criteria: Both loaves of bread are inside the basket, horizontally near the basket’s footprint and above the tabletop; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Approach the bread from above and grip sufficiently thick middle sections of opposing sides, avoiding thin edges, rounded corners, and slopes. Open slightly wider than the selected area to reduce sweeping into nearby objects.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bread and the pads contact its side rather than only pressing on top, avoiding an empty grasp or pushing it away.
- During transport, keep the bread bottom above the basket rim and adjust its orientation where there is clearance above the opening, avoiding catching the bread or fingers on the basket wall.
- If bread is already in the basket, use remaining space or its broad surface for support, avoiding leaning another piece across the rim. Confirm support before release and withdraw upward afterward to reduce falling or shifting the bread.
